note_sections.t: A clinician sought expert evaluation due to consistent antigen elevation and an earlier imaging categorization.

Chronic conditions comprise controlled type 2 diabetes managed with empagliflozin, hypercholesterolaemia treated via simvastatin and rosuvastatin, COPD addressed with PRN salbutamol, and osteoarthritis managed through PRN paracetamol. Urinary function remains largely intact, reflected by an IPSS of 3, and no prior prostate biopsy or transurethral resection has been performed, maintaining a prior biopsy bucket 'None'. Additional medical encounters include a stable cardiology assessment in autumn 2024, a vascular surgery visit for varicose veins, and ongoing pain clinic oversight for persistent shoulder discomfort. A predominantly inactive routine, limited to sporadic walking, characterizes his daily habits. The patient specifically requested extended dialogue regarding his apprehension toward invasive interventions.
